defaultPrompt: Turn this SOP into a validated EFD JSON. / 將這份 SOP 轉成可驗證的 EFD JSON。
Build an EFD from these meeting notes. / 依這份會議紀要建立具象流程圖 JSON。
Validate and repair this .efd.json. / 驗證並修正這份 .efd.json。
interface.longDescription: Create an embodied flow diagram from text with ChatGPT: give EW AI Flowchart an SOP, meeting note, job instruction, process description, or supplied document; it generates and validates an EFD 2.1 .efd.json file. Download that JSON and import it into the AI Embodied Flowchart desktop application to open, review, and continue editing the diagram. The JSON models business stages, organization lanes, typed nodes and edges, node-level RACI, evidence, decisions, and exception paths. Unlike an ordinary flowchart, it preserves machine-readable engineering semantics and stable references. AI generates constrained data rather than executable scripts. Users who need the desktop software can visit the Embodied Worker website. 使用 ChatGPT 文生具象流程圖：將 SOP、會議紀要、工作說明、流程敘述或文件交給 EW AI Flowchart，外掛會產生並驗證 EFD 2.1 .efd.json。下載 JSON 後，上傳至 AI 具象流程圖單機版，即可開啟、檢查並繼續編輯流程圖。JSON 包含流程階段、組織泳道、具類型的節點與連線、節點級 RACI、證據、判斷及例外路徑。不同於一般流程圖，它保存可機器讀取的工程語義與穩定引用；AI 只產生受約束的資料，不執行任意腳本。需要單機軟體的使用者可前往 Embodied Worker 官網。
